# fa-tr-textkit

Offline Python Unicode utilities for Persian and Turkish text, including normalization and search keys.

- Source: https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/fa-tr-textkit
- Source installation: pip install git+https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/fa-tr-textkit.git
- Documentation and examples: https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/fa-tr-textkit#readme
- License: MIT
- Version: 0.1.0
- This is NOT a translation service.
